_: Copy this file, edit, pass via --overrides /path/to/your-copy.json to the backfill script.
_skipEmails_help: Contacts whose Owner email is in this list are skipped entirely. No user created, no adviserId set, case keeps adviserId=null. Use for placeholder / role-based / shared-mailbox Zoho users that aren't actual advisers (e.g. 'unassigned@', 'admin@', team mailboxes). A blank adviser field is honest; one that reads 'Unassigned' is misleading.
_inactiveDomains_help: Emails on these domains are auto-provisioned with status=INACTIVE. Row exists (so header shows adviser name), but the user cannot sign in even if credentials appear later.
_roleOverrides_help: Auto-provisioned users default to role=ADVISER. Use this map to force a different role for specific emails. Values must be one of: CA_TEAM, ADVISER, PARAPLANNER, ADMIN. Applies only to freshly-created users; existing users always keep their current role.
